name: Bastion
source:
Bastion is a collection of stories with a similar theme.

How To Rule The World: Thomas gets drafted to fight in the war, but is enlisted to a secret project.

[From [url=https://thetadog.itch.io/bastion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《壁垒》是一部围绕相近主题展开的短篇故事合集。

《如何统治世界》：托马斯应征入伍奔赴战场，却意外被编入了一项绝密计划之中。

[摘自[url=https://thetadog.itch.io/bastion]itch.io[/url]]
